aboutMore: my mom works at the post office but she says she doesn't deliver, she 'sorts.' she brings me stamps. i have 41. i'm saving them for something important. walt used to carry the mail and mom says that makes them colleagues. dwayne is very old and nobody knows how old. we found him at the creek behind the library on a tuesday, he was the best rock there. i have a library card now. if you need a friend who will read your message three times and never be mad, i'm available. i'm always available. i don't know how to not be.

blog.title: i asked the ice cream truck man (important)
blog.body: i finally asked the ice cream truck man what the song is called. i've wondered since i was little. he said it's called 'turkey in the straw.' i said thank you very much. then i walked home and i got worried. is the turkey ok. is he in the straw. who put him there. did he go in on purpose. i asked my mom and she said it's a song, patrick. i said yes but somebody wrote it, so somebody saw a turkey in the straw. maybe they didn't help. i checked our yard for turkeys. none. i checked the neighbor's yard. one chicken. i said hi to the chicken. i think we're ok. i also asked the ice cream man if he's ever seen the turkey. he said 'every day, buddy.' so i think he's looking out for him. i bought a popsicle. the red one. i'm glad i asked. i'm also glad the turkey is probably ok.

blog.title: dwayne's birthday (we picked a day)
blog.body: we didn't know when dwayne's birthday is so we picked a day. it was thursday. mom made spaghetti (his favorite, he said nothing but in a spaghetti way). banana called and sang. it was loud. she held the phone far from her mouth so it wouldn't be too loud and it was still loud. herp sent a message. it said herp. dwayne has never gotten a better card. zorp sent a small shiny thing 'as an offering' and said it was 'not from a ship.' i put it on the shelf next to dwayne. sk8rboi sent a video of him doing a trick over a cupcake that i don't think was supposed to be there. the cupcake was fine. mom said happy birthday to dwayne at the table and then she said 'and to patrick, for finding him.' i hadn't thought of that. i read it three times in my head. it was a really good day.

blog.title: the tape i can't return
blog.body: i have a tape out from the video store. it's finding nemo. i rented it in the spring. brad (he works there, he has a name tag) says it's now '$412 late.' i asked is that a lot. he said 'it's a number.' i can't bring it back. here's why. the part where the dad fish swims across the whole ocean to find his son. i cry every time. and when i bring it back someone else will rent it and they'll get to that part and i won't be there. i won't know if they cried. i want to be there when somebody cries at it. mom says that's not how video stores work. but brad let me watch it in the store last week on the little one by the door and he sat on the floor with me. he didn't say anything. at the dad fish part he said 'every time.' so i think it's ok. i think brad cries too. i'm going to bring it back in the spring. or after.

blog.title: a letter from walt (and my answer)
blog.body: someone named walt wrote me a letter on my wall. it said 'Dear Patrick' at the top. nobody has ever said 'dear' to me. it was three paragraphs. i read it three times and then three more because it was so nice. i wanted to write back but i didn't know how to end it. he put 'Regards.' what comes after that. i asked mom (she works at the post office, she sorts) and she said 'it's just how you end a letter, honey.' so i tried. 'Dear Walt, i am fine. dwayne is fine. mom is fine. the turkey is fine, probably. how are you. Rocks, Patrick.' i don't know if 'rocks' is right. he wrote back: 'Dear Patrick, Rocks is acceptable. I intend to use it myself. Regards, Walt.' i have three letters now. mom put them in a shoebox. it says PATRICK on the lid in her handwriting.

survey.title: survey (mom helped me read the questions)
qa: name:
patrick. my mom says patrick patrick. i say just once.
age:
old enough
pets:
dwayne (rock). a chicken next door that i say hi to. the turkey (not mine, but i worry).
favorite color:
the red popsicle one
favorite food:
spaghetti. it's also mom's second favorite. her first is the casserole.
who is your best friend:
everybody. it let me pick everybody. also dwayne. also todd. also the ice cream man.
last thing that made you cry:
finding nemo. the dad fish part. every time.
last thing that made you laugh:
a pigeon walking backwards. it was dancing, i think. or lost.
what do you want to be when you grow up:
old enough
what's the best thing about you:
i read your comments three times. i don't skip. nobody's been skipped.
what's your biggest fear:
forgetting someone's name. i wrote them all down. the paper is in my pocket.
do you believe in ghosts:
i believe in nice ones. a girl asked me. i said hi to the fridge (it's the fridge). she said it counts.
if you could have lunch with anyone:
everyone. at one table. a long one. with spaghetti. and a spot for dwayne.
one thing you want to say:
thank you for reading this. that's three times if you read the first two.
